Company description:
Phoenix Health specialise in providing weight loss (bariatric) surgery to both NHS and private, fee-paying patients. It’s all we do and we’re passionate about the highly professional service we provide.

The Phoenix Health LinkedIn channel is here to bring you insight into the weight loss surgery industry from Phoenix Health’s perspective, allow professionals considering weight loss surgery to connect with us or encourage weight loss surgery professionals to engage with our brand. 

Acknowledged and award-winning experts, we have an enviable reputation not just for excellent clinical outcomes but also for our friendly, caring, and holistic approach to patients who we treat with respect and understanding. To us, a patient isn't just ‘another operation’, but someone we recognise has struggled for years with their personal demons before having the courage to approach us for help. We know that it’s foolish and short-sighted to assume that just treating someone’s stomach is going to deal with all of their weight issues so we've developed the skills to tackle a wide range of eating problems above and below the neck! That way, we can maximise the chances of long-term success rather than just providing a quick fix.

Phoenix Health offers the highest standard of weight loss surgery and enhanced aftercare packages that when followed correctly, will help our clients achieve their weight loss goals. With tiered price plans and the most comprehensive range of keyhole surgical procedures available in the UK and Ireland, we will ensure our clients get the highest levels of care, helping them get their life right back where they want it.
Company specialities: Weight Loss Surgery, Bariatric Surgery, Gastric Sleeve, Gastric band, Gastric Bypass, Mini Gastric Bypass, Gastric Balloon, Revisional Surgery
